The original-value metadata regression first reproduced this defect; the bounded production correction now carries the actual load period to the fallback, and all seven precision tests/nineteen subtests pass including strict native Monthly/Annual graph identity. Original Hourly heating Rate independently integrates to the same value from thirteen positive hours among 744 August observations. Outdoor air therefore remains unsplit storage/other rather than being relabeled as measured mechanical ventilation. Internal and surface aggregate remainders subtract only declared applicable families, with WEST lighting explicitly outside membership. No duplicate total/rate or equipment thermal context enters the main load/consumption chain. The original SQL has 167 Monthly identities (155 variables and twelve meters), all with twelve finite non-NULL observations, and 36 Hourly identities each with 8760 finite observations. Basic Energy remains lightweight under EPATH-101: no new fan/pump/airflow output requests are added. Individual Fan, FanCoilFan and Pump electricity is unrequested and unobserved at every frequency. Six original terminal inlet/outlet Hourly mass-flow series exist, but the local fans have no AirLoop and no qualifying measured pool/supply-volume evidence, so broad Fans remain unassigned. The two original pumps have separate single-service typed plant ownership and all three serviced Zones; the recipe requires explicit plant_loop_load_share estimation using cooling-plus-heating Zone loads, not fictitious measured pump shares. The currently reproduced component-level PlantLoop-by-service Cartesian product is not physical ownership evidence: it must be corrected to exact water-coil/Branch/PlantLoop membership before this declaration can pass a saved current-code candidate. Unknown, conflicting or genuinely shared plant service cannot be rescued by scope filtering or blanket ambiguity relaxation. Original input and closed capture files remain unchanged; executed input SHA256 92826e6a0d1ab3961f485d0088f3426fdc45b409eef879fb4b5d0c4e315187b1 and controlled Chicago TMY3 weather retain their catalog bindings. Native engine completion is 7.73 seconds with seven warnings and no Severe/Fatal; the stored parser has eight issues because it separately records the unavailable-variable header. Neither count is suppressed. Complete independent eight-group numerical/field coverage, explicit review and saved expected-manifest acceptance are still required; this recipe alone approves nothing.
